patch_description:
Redesigns the EVOLVE-BLOCK ansatz ordering for better information flow and trainability:
- Uses shared RZ “pre” rotations on two banks (qubits 0–3 vs 4–7).
- Applies trainable CRZ entanglers (ring + opposite-chord) with only two shared parameters (chi_ring, chi_chord) to keep parameter efficiency high.
- Moves the shared RY layer to *after* entanglement (RY “post”), then finishes with a shared RZ “post” layer.
This implements the suggested RZ_pre → CRZ entanglers → RY → RZ_post structure to improve convergence and generalization while keeping the fixed training/feature map/measurement pipeline unchanged.
